Then the maximum height to which the combined system reaches above the top of the building before falling below is - (g = 10 ms<sup>–2</sup>)

Speed of wood just before collision = gt = 10 m/s

= 100 10 = 90 m/s

(0.02) (1v) + (0.02) (9v) = (0.05)v

   150 = 5v
